note: Revised longer lines with scene context. Speakers and story beats unchanged. Be still remains one command.

DAVID.lotrReference: Frodo at Mount Doom (matured Elijah Wood)

cues.speaker: TORTURER
cues.exactDialogue: Renounce the promise, first father, and this ends. One word from you, and I loose the hook.
cues.style: Low, dry, judicial, almost conversational. Controlled false mercy. No growl, no shout.

cues.speaker: ADAM
cues.exactDialogue: The promise is not mine to renounce. I did not speak it into being, and I will not unsay it here.
cues.style: Weathered, exhausted, firm final word. Conviction under pain, not heroic shout.

cues.speaker: TORTURER
cues.exactDialogue: You are dust. Dust has no inheritance. Tell me what ashes may claim from the living God.
cues.style: Calm cruelty. Dry courtroom contempt. No laugh or snarl.

cues.speaker: ADAM
cues.exactDialogue: I am dust—and guilty before Him. Yet the dust is His, and still I belong to God.
cues.style: One painful breath on the dash. Confession then quiet belonging. No triumph.

cues.speaker: TORTURER
cues.exactDialogue: Look upon the inheritance of rebellion. Kingdoms fall, names perish, and every proud crown is broken here.
cues.style: Distant ceremonial address. Falsely authoritative. Quiet and grave.

cues.speaker: EVE
cues.exactDialogue: Adam—look at me. Let not his darkness make strangers of us again.
cues.style: Intimate, cracked but controlled. Name catches; do not scream the name.

cues.speaker: MOSES
cues.exactDialogue: Hold fast, Adam. These chains may bind the hand, but not the promise.
cues.style: Firm chained witness. No pulpit cadence. Reassure without sentimentality.

cues.speaker: MOSES
cues.exactDialogue: You do not wait alone.
cues.style: Quiet after the longer line. Intimate certainty. No sermon.

cues.speaker: MOSES
cues.exactDialogue: He claims no innocence, and asks no wage. He waits upon the mercy of the God who judges him.
cues.style: Measured testimony. Stress mercy, not innocence. No sermon tone.

cues.speaker: TORTURER
cues.exactDialogue: Your Messiah is dead. His blood is cold, and the grave has sealed its mouth upon Him.
cues.style: Nearly whispered, certain, unadorned. Controlled malice hiding unease.

cues.speaker: MOSES
cues.exactDialogue: Then why do you tremble? You did not gather the faithful by judgment.
cues.style: Quiet exact accusation. Unhurried moral force. No triumph.

cues.speaker: MOSES
cues.exactDialogue: You seized them because His death frightened you.
cues.style: The second half of the accusation. Unhurried. No triumph.

cues.speaker: TORTURER
cues.exactDialogue: Then let Him come. Let Him descend into my kingdom. Adam shall be the pledge of His defeat.
cues.style: Controlled bravado masking fear. Short pause after come. Hostage threat, not roar.

cues.speaker: TORTURER
cues.exactDialogue: You blamed her once, when fear found you in the garden. Will you condemn her again, here before all the dead?
cues.style: Surgical, intimate, divisive. Emphasis on her and again. Do not shout.

cues.speaker: EVE
cues.exactDialogue: No. I chose the serpent’s lie, and the wound is mine. I will not escape my guilt by choosing your lie now.
cues.style: Clear-eyed confession. Grow unwavering. Finish quietly. No sob through the line.

cues.speaker: TORTURER
cues.exactDialogue: In the garden, when judgment found you, you set her name between yourself and the face of God.
cues.style: Quieter than the prior challenge. Forensic, pressing an old wound.

cues.speaker: ADAM
cues.exactDialogue: I named her when I should have confessed. I made of her a shield for my fear.
cues.style: Remorse first, resolve second.

cues.speaker: ADAM
cues.exactDialogue: Never again.
cues.style: Resolve only. Short. No shout.

cues.speaker: ADAM
cues.exactDialogue: He found us hiding among the trees, clothed only in shame. Yet He covered us with His own hand.
cues.style: Memory softens the voice without making it dreamy.

cues.speaker: ADAM
cues.exactDialogue: Then He promised the woman’s Son would crush the serpent. The wound would be His, and the victory would be God’s.
cues.style: Light weight on promised and Son. Quiet certainty, not sermon.

cues.speaker: TORTURER
cues.exactDialogue: Sons beyond counting have crossed these gates: kings, prophets, beggars, all swallowed by the same night.
cues.style: Public-address projection without doubling or roar.

cues.speaker: TORTURER
cues.exactDialogue: So where is the Son you were promised? Why does He not answer from beyond the stone?
cues.style: Contempt on promised, unease underneath. No laugh.

cues.speaker: DAVID
cues.exactDialogue: You will not abandon my soul to Sheol. Even in the depths, I will wait for You.
cues.style: Narrow psalmic cantillation, halfway between speech and a restrained chant. Intimate, unaccompanied.

cues.speaker: DAVID
cues.exactDialogue: Nor will You let Your Holy One see corruption. The grave shall not possess Him.
cues.style: Continue the same psalmic breath-world. Holy One is the quiet peak. No Broadway vibrato.

cues.speaker: JOHN
cues.exactDialogue: Be still.
cues.style: Close, dry whisper with authority. Almost under the breath.

cues.speaker: JOHN
cues.exactDialogue: I know that tread. I heard it beside the Jordan, when heaven opened and the waters bore witness.
cues.style: Recognition, not exposition. Small astonished joy only on Jordan.

cues.speaker: JOHN
cues.exactDialogue: Death has taken the One whom death cannot hold. The grave has opened its mouth upon its own undoing.
cues.style: Strong but not shouted. Hushed certainty, not celebration.
